issues.title: Testing for narrow texts and not allowing them
issues.description: Multi-column tables and prose containers squished multi-line prose into narrow vertical strips (< 160px).
issues.resolution: Add minimum column widths (.prose table th/td min-width, /development table min-widths) and automated Playwright layout-glitches assertions across 8 representative routes.
issues.evidence: Verified across 8 routes in tests/ux/layout-glitches.spec.mjs (0 narrow multi-line violations).

issues.title: Interactive Lab weird UI
issues.description: CodeRunner button icon-text gap, mid-snippet height clipping, scientific notation -5 highlighted as shell flag, font-weight mismatch between textarea and syntax overlay.
clarificationQuestions: Confirmed whether fixes to CodeRunner.tsx and SyntaxHighlighter.ts cover the Interactive Lab UI feedback.
issues.resolution: Approved: CodeRunner and SyntaxHighlighter fixes cover the Interactive Lab UI issues.
issues.evidence: Verified syntax overlay alignment, 38rem max height, scientific notation tokenization, and 200 DPI matplotlib rendering.

issues.title: Trailing commas and punctuation wrapping to start of new line after formulas
issues.description: Inline KaTeX formulas and <Ref /> elements allowed trailing commas, periods, and closing parens to wrap onto the start of the next line.
issues.resolution: Attach trailing punctuation into the final .base span inside .katex-html via glueInlinePunctuationRehypePlugin and wrap <Ref>/<Math> + punctuation in whitespace-nowrap.
issues.evidence: Verified 0 line-start punctuation breaks and 0px mobile horizontal overflow in tests/ux/ux-report.spec.mjs.

issues.title: Line gap and vertical spacing around dense formulas
issues.description: Single-line $$...$$ formulas were parsed as inlineMath instead of display math, and dense formula paragraphs lacked vertical breathing room.
issues.resolution: Promote single-line $$...$$ to math-display, use htmlAndMathml output, and increase prose line-height (leading-[1.9] / leading-[1.85]).
issues.evidence: Verified display math spacing and 0 height jumps in tests/ux/interactive-jumps.spec.mjs.

issues.title: Diagram zoom range (50% to 600%) and crisp high-res zoom-in
issues.description: Diagram zoom was clamped at 100% minimum and used GPU layer caching (will-change: transform, translate3d) that blurred SVGs when zoomed in.
issues.resolution: Lower DIAGRAM_MIN_SCALE to 0.5 (50%), raise DIAGRAM_MAX_SCALE to 6 (600%), remove GPU bitmap layer caching on SVGs, and raise PythonDiagram PNG fallback DPI to 300.
issues.evidence: Verified 50%-600% zoom bounds and crisp SVG vector re-rasterization.

issues.title: Rapid AI Dev: previewing changes, commenting, and pilot expansion approval
issues.description: Develop a way for harnesses to preview all new changes, comment, and approve expanding beyond pilot as a series of skills and scripts.
clarificationQuestions: How should Rapid AI Dev & Automated AI Dev be packaged?
issues.resolution: Create repo-local agent skills (.agents/skills/) and CLI workflow script (scripts/ai_dev_workflow.mjs) for previewing diffs, affected routes, comments, and pilot expansion gates.
issues.evidence: Verified via tests/ai-dev-workflow.test.mjs and npm run ai:preview.

issues.title: Automated AI Dev: issue -> clarify -> approve -> implement -> review workflow
issues.description: Automate the lifecycle for page review issues to get clarified, approved, worked on, and marked ready for review again.
clarificationQuestions: How should the issue clarification and review queue be structured?
issues.resolution: Implemented Git-tracked ISSUE_QUEUE.json state machine and .agents/skills/automated-issue-workflow/SKILL.md.
issues.evidence: Verified state transitions and CLI commands in tests/ai-dev-workflow.test.mjs.

issues.title: Themes: Remove scholar, make a sensible default
issues.description: Remove the scholar theme and ensure modern is the clean default theme alongside monochrome.
issues.resolution: Removed scholar theme from themes.ts, ThemeToggle.tsx, global.css, devThemer.ts, Layout.astro, and all test suites.
issues.evidence: Verified via node scripts/test_theme_tokens.mjs and Playwright contrast suites.

issues.title: Refactor career paths around Software Engineer study guide
issues.description: Build a comprehensive Software Engineer career study guide focused on what to read, skills to acquire, and programming languages to focus on, without self-assessment writing forms.
clarificationQuestions: Which career path and structure should replace the current Systems Foundations path?
issues.resolution: Built Software Engineer career roadmap (languages, skill pillars, canonical reading list, 4-stage study sequence) and removed self-assessment writing forms.
issues.evidence: Verified schema, contract tests, E2E smoke test, and UX/accessibility checks on /careers/software-engineer.html.

issues.title: Side tools: built-in highlighter and clock with Pomodoro timer
issues.description: Provide built-in side tools on lesson pages with a multi-color highlighter, notes, jump list, clock, and Pomodoro timer.
clarificationQuestions: What scope and UX should the built-in side tools have?
issues.resolution: Collapsible right-hand utility drawer/floating rail on lesson pages with localStorage highlights (multi-color + note + jump list) and a study clock + configurable Pomodoro timer.
issues.evidence: Verified StudyToolsRail launcher, dialog, Pomodoro timer, and highlighter in E2E smoke and UX suites.

issues.title: Replace synthetic K-Means course clustering on /development
issues.description: Running k=3 K-Means and 8-PC PCA on N=4 courses produced synthetic clusters and a meaningless statistical outlier warning.
clarificationQuestions: Confirmed whether category-based grouping and rank-bounded PCA cover the clustering feedback.
issues.resolution: Replaced synthetic K-Means and outlier warning with actual subject-category grouping, labeled scatter points, rank-bounded PCA (N-1 = 3 components), and factual component-coverage notes.
